messages.subject: ctmm winter webinar
parts:
There will be a 1-hour webinar on both basic features (variograms & AKDE) and new features in ctmm (meta-analyses, RSFs, and RSF-kernel AKDEs) next month, followed by a question-and-answer session. You can vote on the schedule here:

https://doodle.com/poll/su4wafk8sav5b3ei?utm_source=poll&utm_medium=link

The webinar will take place using the same Skype group as before, "ctmm webinar". If you didn't participate last time, then I will need your Skype user name to add to the group. You will need a regular Skype account and software. "Skype for business" is not compatible.

Attached is an image of an tapir home range, as estimated with an RSF-kernel AKDE, where tree cover is selected.
